description: Use official MicroG-RE 7.2.1 for Google Maps. Prefer synthesized navigation speech when available, with the existing audio fallback. Requires working TTS voice data; compatibility with every Maps release is not guaranteed.

patches.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.1 and prefers synthesized navigation speech with the existing audio fallback.

release_notes:
- Reuse Morphe Patches Library 1.4.1 helpers and share invoke-register handling between Maps and TTS hooks.
- Add method, opcode, register and branch details to navigation TTS layout errors.
